title: Valgard, your own cyber defense team
description: Valgard is a proactive cyber defense add-on from Scalytics: your own cyber defense team. Find it, block it, prove it. It runs on hardware you own, as an add-on to Lascaris Streamhouse or the Kafka you already run: Confluent, Apache Kafka, Redpanda or Amazon MSK. It finds known exploited flaws, using the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (KEV) and FIRST's Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS), on your own assets inside a scope you sign. Time-boxed blocks on F5, Palo Alto and OPNsense lift themselves on a timer. Bigger changes wait for your approval. A rescan and signed records are evidence for NIS2 and DORA. Valgard is in alpha, in internal testing, and is not generally available. It has no published price. Design partners can register interest at https://www.scalytics.io/contact.
